content.title: About
content.content: Crisp is a fresh apple variety known for its crunchy texture, juiciness, and bright sweet‑tart flavor. Grown in temperate climates, the apples are harvested at peak ripeness and quickly packaged to preserve their natural crispness.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The “Crisp” name comes from the distinctive crunch felt when biting into the fruit.
Crisp apples are popular in baking because they hold their shape well in pies and tarts.
Vitamin C content in Crisp apples is higher than average for most apple varieties.
When stored properly, Crisp apples can keep their quality for up to 6 months.
The aroma of Crisp apples often intensifies after a few days at room temperature.

items.title: Rich in vitamin C
items.content: Vitamin C supports the immune system and aids collagen synthesis.

items.title: Contains dietary fiber
items.content: Fiber promotes healthy digestion and helps maintain a feeling of fullness.

items.title: Low in calories
items.content: Crisp apples make an excellent snack for weight management.

items.title: Antioxidants
items.content: Flavonoids and polyphenols help protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Supports cardiovascular health
items.content: Potassium in the apples contributes to normal blood pressure.

items.title: Apple allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions such as itching, swelling, or hives.

items.title: Pesticide residues
items.content: Improperly treated fruit may retain pesticide residues; washing thoroughly is recommended.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: High acidity can irritate the stomach lining in people with gastritis or ulcers.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Crisp apples can be eaten fresh, sliced into salads, added to smoothies, baked in pies, or made into sauces. They also serve as a healthy snack between meals.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store apples in the refrigerator’s fruit drawer, in a sealed bag or container. At room temperature they keep for about a week but lose crispness more quickly.
